$comment: Registry of every upstream source the pipeline watches. Add entries with /add-source (existing type) or /add-adapter (new type). Credentials live in .env (NEVER here). Each source's last-seen fingerprint lives in .sync-state.json. Arrays start empty — the builder walk fills them.

$examples.$comment: Reference shapes only — NOT live sources. Real entries go in the arrays below.

figma.label: Design System (tokens, components, styles)
figma.$note: Free-form note: quirks, auth path, what to skip. See pipeline/adapters/figma.md.

repos.label: Marketing site / web app
repos.$note: Cheap gate: git diff <lastSha>..origin/<branch> --name-only. See pipeline/adapters/github.md.

websites.label: Marketing site
websites.$note: Cheap gate: sitemap <lastmod> + ETag/If-Modified-Since. See pipeline/adapters/website.md.

monday.label: Product roadmap board
monday.$note: GraphQL-only (no REST). Cheap gate: boards(ids){updated_at items_count}. Delta via activity_logs(from:lastSync). Allowlist board IDs — never crawl the workspace. See pipeline/adapters/monday.md.

ga.label: GA4 property — site analytics
ga.$note: GA4 Data API (runReport). First metrics/time-series source: cheap gate = sessions-by-date over a trailing window; delta = new/restated days, not a stop-if-unchanged hash. Auth: ADC (gcloud, for viewer-only props) or GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS service account added as property Viewer. See pipeline/adapters/ga.md.
